results.name: An authorized admin can assign a judge to an eligible submitted entry
The assignment records who assigned it (assigned_by), not just when
A non-admin cannot assign a judge (real role check, not a client-asserted permission)
A duplicate assignment is a real database no-op, never a second row
Exactly one real assignment row exists after the duplicate attempt
Assigning a judge to a still-editable draft entry (never submitted) is rejected
Test setup: a real authenticated entrant account logs in
An entrant can never be assigned as the judge of their own submitted entry
A judge with no real active membership for a venue-scoped competition's venue is denied assignment
A judge with a real active venue membership is assigned successfully
